entries.55e15b15cd54a7a2: To achieve its mission, "Enhancing time value through technology," and its vision, "Life infrastructure that connects the happiness of local communities," the company has set growth of the food delivery market and improvement of its competitiveness as its priority issues. Through steps such as introducing variable delivery fees (dynamic pricing), improving the accuracy of estimated delivery times, improving the quality of delivery and customer service, and expanding the lineup of partner stores, the company says it aims to realize "making delivery part of everyday life." Its priority issues include further expanding sharing delivery, securing couriers, improving delivery efficiency and increasing the number of active users.
